title: Update Design Diagram Connector Colors
description: Update the design diagram connector colors so the default state illustrates compatible connectors across the entire design in semio colors. Fix individual selection of a single connector so selecting one greys out unrelated connectors, highlights the selected connector, and shows compatible vs incompatible connectors in compose red/green.
summary: Normalized Design app connector selection to a single canonical connector record plus a synced one-item connectors array. DESIGN.SET_SELECTION, selector reads, store selection diffs, and piece/connection selection transitions now all pass through the same normalization so connector selection cannot drift into multi-selected state. Extended the existing embedded Playwright Design coverage to assert only one diagram connector handle reports selected after each click and that raw connector-array selection is normalized back to a single selected connector.
